verdicts.title: Moculus: an immersive virtual reality system for mice incorporating stereo vision
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Due to technical roadblocks, it is unclear how visual circuits represent multiple features or how behaviorally relevant representations are selected for long-term memory. Here we developed Moculus, a head-mounted virtual reality platform for mice that covers the entire visual field, and allows binocular depth perception and full visual immersion.
